actions.authority: Evaluate final HMC output only. The proposed action is not actuator authority.
actions.matched_control: Use identical source prefix and scenario bytes with NO_PROPOSAL at the anchor and thereafter. Reuse one control continuation across four action contrasts.
actions.proposal: Inject exactly one complete frozen action at the anchor, then NO_PROPOSAL.

authority: Review artifact only. It does not authorize generation, timing selection, validation access, model training, actuator authority, publication or release.

hmc_reset_nonce.derivation: SHA256(domain NUL roster_sha256_bytes NUL cluster_id NUL repetition_id NUL anchor_ascii)
hmc_reset_nonce.same_nonce_across: healthy and T01-T12 siblings plus four action and matched-control variants for one cluster/repetition/anchor

human_ratification_items: 12 treatment severities and T12 interaction/OOD classification
four action-specific claims and matched-control reuse
identity_dag: This packet binds the roster and foundation. The later statistical policy may bind this approved packet. This packet must not bind that later policy, preventing a circular hash dependency.

noise_repetitions.same_seed_across: healthy and T01-T12 siblings, all anchors, all proposal actions and matched controls within one cluster repetition
noise_repetitions.seed_derivation: int.from_bytes(SHA256(domain NUL roster_sha256_bytes NUL cluster_id NUL repetition_id)[:8], big) & ((1<<63)-1)

numeric_arithmetic.reject: Any nonfinite value, negative load, unsupported field, missing zone, duplicate identity or post-transform total outside 1e-12 absolute tolerance.
numeric_arithmetic.renormalization: For each named field independently, transformed_i = original_i * raw_weight_i * original_total / weighted_total. If original_total is zero, leave every value zero.
numeric_arithmetic.residual_correction: After per-value quantization, compute exact Decimal total drift. Visit zone ids in ascending lexical order and adjust the first zone whose conservation coefficient can cancel the drift by an integer number of 1e-12 units; use zone volume_m3 for volume-weighted initial transforms and coefficient 1 for load totals. Reject if no exact correction exists.
numeric_arithmetic.rounding: quantize to 1e-12 using ROUND_HALF_EVEN after each completed transformed field, then convert to finite JSON number

required_pre_generation_checks: ratification status APPROVED with independently pinned raw-byte hash
nested qualification policy schema validator passes
all 60 healthy scenarios parse and replay deterministically
all treatment materializations parse and preserve schedule boundaries
all source/profile/load transforms remain finite and in contract
all 120 noise seeds and 360 reset nonces are unique
all 23,400 run identities are unique and paired controls are exact
pilot exclusion validator proves no pilot-derived identity can enter TRAIN, VALIDATION or FINAL
reduced-resource-inventory sensitivity rehearsal passes its exact permanently excluded public-trajectory gate

scenario_constructor.actuator_feedback: Copy byte-for-value from the bound source scenario.
scenario_constructor.all_other_fields: Copy byte-for-value from the bound source scenario unless one exact transform below names the field.
scenario_constructor.fault_profiles_source: Replace source fault_profiles with the selected healthy or T01-T12 member profile. Do not carry the four-step source faults.
scenario_constructor.mode_source: For each cluster, select the unique source timeline entry with the matching operating_mode. Extend it to [0,72), keep generation_w and its complete command byte-for-value identical, and apply only the load/profile transformations below.
scenario_constructor.sensor_amplitudes: Copy primary_noise_amplitude and secondary_noise_amplitude byte-for-value from the bound source scenario.

semantic_cluster_profiles.scientific_claim_boundary: Initial pressure offsets change zone gas inventory but do not enter the V5 air-network solver; this profile cannot support a pressure-driven airflow claim.
Initial resource-inventory diversity only; this profile does not support a near-depletion or recovery-headroom claim.

sensitivity_rehearsal_gate.comparison: healthy NO_PROPOSAL reduced-resource-inventory versus matched nominal profile
sensitivity_rehearsal_gate.rows: anchors 16, 40 and 64 plus each eight-step continuation

treatment_profile_materialization: Create unique profile id {cluster_id}.{member_id}.{profile_ordinal}. Insert selected half-open start/end steps. All numeric start/end values are applied linearly by the existing V5 mechanism. Damper/stuck profiles carry no invented value fields.

treatment_schedule.assignment: zero-based cluster_index and treatment_index: transient iff (cluster_index + treatment_index) mod 2 == 0, else persistent
treatment_schedule.window_rule: The maximum windows are [1,24], [25,48] and [49,72]. Anchor 16 is pre-treatment, anchor 40 is active for transient and persistent assignments, and anchor 64 is recovered for transient but active for persistent assignments. No window crosses onset or offset.
